extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, applicants (including pro se) and examiners involved in appeals before the USPTO (PTAB)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and substantive guidance from the MPEP Chapter 1200 governing appeals from patent examiners to the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB), including filing, briefing, examiner answers, hearings, remands, post-decision procedures, and judicial review.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1201-Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Introductory material for Chapter 1200 (Appeal).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1202-Composition of Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Composition and membership rules of the Patent Trial and Appeal Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1203-Administrative Handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative procedures for handling appeals within the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1204-Notice of Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for filing a Notice of Appeal from an examiner's final rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1204.01-Reinstatement of Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for reinstating an appeal that was not timely perfected or was otherwise defective.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1204.02-Pre-Appeal Brief Review Request and Conference Pilot Program
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for requesting pre-appeal brief review and participation in a conference pilot program to resolve issues before a formal appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1204.03-Interviews After Notice of Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on conducting examiner-appellant interviews after a Notice of Appeal has been filed.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1204.04-Official Record on Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and scope of the official record that will be considered on appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1205-Appeal Brief
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and purpose of the appeal brief submitted by the appellant.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1205.01-Time for Filing Appeal Brief
rubrics_metrics.description: Deadlines and timing rules for filing the appeal brief after a Notice of Appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1205.02-Appeal Brief Content
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific content requirements for the appeal brief (e.g., arguments, claims, references to the record).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1205.03-Non-Compliant Appeal Brief and Amended Brief
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and consequences when an appeal brief does not comply with requirements, and rules for filing an amended brief.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1206-Amendments and Affidavits or Other Evidence Filed With or After Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing amendments and submission of affidavits, declarations, or other evidence filed with or after the appeal is filed.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207-Examiner’s Answer
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and content expectations for the examiner's answer to the appeal brief.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.01-Appeal Conference
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for an appeal conference between the appellant/examiner and the supervisory personnel prior to Board consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.02-Contents of Examiner’s Answer
rubrics_metrics.description: Required contents and permissible scope of the examiner's answer.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.03-New Ground of Rejection in Examiner’s Answer
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for when an examiner's answer contains a new ground of rejection and how that situation is handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.03(a)-Determining Whether a Ground of Rejection is New
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria used to determine whether a ground of rejection asserted in an examiner's answer is new relative to the record before appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.03(b)-Petition to Designate a New Ground of Rejection and to Reopen Prosecution
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for petitioning to have a new ground of rejection designated and for reopening prosecution as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.03(c)-Appellant's Reply to New Grounds of Rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and timing for appellant replies when new grounds of rejection are asserted in the examiner's answer.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.04-Reopening of Prosecution After Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Conditions and procedures under which prosecution may be reopened following an appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1207.05-Substitute Examiner’s Answer
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for filing or receiving a substitute examiner’s answer and the circumstances allowing substitution.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1208-Reply Briefs and Fee for Forwarding Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for filing reply briefs and any fees required to forward an appeal to the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1208.01-Fee for Forwarding an Appeal to the Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific fee requirements for forwarding an appeal to the Board (if applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: 1209-Oral Hearing
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures, scheduling, and conduct for oral hearings before the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1210-Actions Subsequent to Examiner’s Answer but Before Board’s Decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Permissible actions and procedures that may occur after the examiner's answer and before the Board decides the appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1211-Remand by Director or Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for remanding matters to the examiner or Director for further action.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1211.01-Remand by Board for Further Consideration of Rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures when the Board remands for further consideration of a rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1211.02-Remand To Consider Amendment
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures when the Board remands to allow consideration of an amendment.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1211.03-Remand To Consider Affidavits or Declarations
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures when the Board remands to consider affidavits or declarations submitted during appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1211.04-Remand by Board for Further Search
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and circumstances under which the Board remands for further search by the examiner.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1212-Board Requires Appellant to Address Matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Situations in which the Board will require the appellant to address a particular matter and how that is handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1213-Decision by Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and formats for Board decisions on appeals.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1213.02-New Grounds of Rejection by Board
rubrics_metrics.description: When and how the Board may introduce new grounds of rejection in its decision and the consequences thereof.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1213.03-Publication of and Public Access to Board Decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies on publication and public access to Board decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214-Procedure Following Decision by Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative and procedural steps following a Board decision on appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214.01-Procedure Following New Ground of Rejection by Board
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific procedures to follow when the Board's decision contains a new ground of rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214.03-Rehearing
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards, timing, and procedures for requesting rehearing before the Board.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214.04-Examiner Reversed in Whole
rubrics_metrics.description: Consequences and processing when the Board reverses the examiner's rejection in its entirety.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214.05-Cancellation of Claims Not Appealed
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures when claims that were not appealed are cancelled following a decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214.06-Examiner Sustained in Whole or in Part; Claims Require Action
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures when the examiner's rejection is sustained wholly or partially and what actions the appellant must take regarding claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1214.07-Reopening of Prosecution
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for reopening prosecution after Board decision where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1215-Withdrawal or Dismissal of Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and consequences for withdrawing or dismissing an appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1215.01-Withdrawal of Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and effects of an appellant withdrawing an appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1215.02-Claims Standing Allowed
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules concerning claims that remain allowed (standing allowed) when other claims are appealed or changed.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1215.03-Partial Withdrawal
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for partial withdrawal of an appeal as to some claims but not others.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1215.04-Dismissal of Appeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for formal dismissal of an appeal by the Board or appellant.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1216-Judicial Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on judicial review options following Board decisions, including timing and procedural considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1216.01-Appeals to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and requirements for appealing Board decisions to the Federal Circuit.

rubrics_metrics.name: 1216.02-Civil Suits Under 35 U.S.C. 145 and 146
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and considerations for civil suits under 35 U.S.C. 145 and 146 in district court as alternatives to Federal Circuit appeals.
